def transform(grid):
    # Extend the top pattern vertically through the blank region above the full-width divider.
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    div=next((r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]==2), None)
    if div is None: return g
    top=g[0]
    # Pattern color in top row; mark column(s) whose top value occurs in bottom marker.
    below=next((row for row in g[div+1:] if any(v for v in row)), [])
    color=next((v for v in top if v!=0),0)
    cols=[c for c,v in enumerate(below) if v==color]
    for r in range(1,div):
        for c in cols:
            if g[r][c]==0: g[r][c]=4
    return g
PY

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    divider=next((r for r,row in enumerate(g) if all(v==2 for v in row)),None)
    if divider is None:

    marker=next((row for row in g[divider+1:] if any(row)),[])
    color=next((v for v in top if v),0)
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if top[c]==color and marker[c]==color]

        for c in cols:

    return g
